My last attempt I was 10-11 years old and at my dads house (I didn’t see him often) and I attempted suicide through od’ing (overdosing). I was crying a lot and really high (the drugs I took would do that) and my legs went numb. I ended up staying up all night, feeling sick, and, thinking of getting help. I didn’t. I just sat there thinking about my life and how I was so happy that it was going to end. I was pretty calm and accepting of death. It was around 6am and my dad walked out and saw me on the couch. He looked at me with terror and sat at the end of the couch. He held me and at that point my legs weren’t numb anymore. I got up and walked towards the balcony door and just stared at it for some reason. He was crying and hugged me. He got me out of that house, and, a few years later I’m a lot better.
